title: Inventory Receiving, Explicit Lineage, Quality and Allocation Operator Workflow
scope: Bounded pilot inventory operator boundary over the existing SW0 inventory and explicit lineage kernels.
claims: inventory receive/quality/transform/derived-receive/allocation actions require real Authority grants
custody is not inferred from UI role; receiving operator must be the declared custodian in this pilot workflow
derived lots must match explicit per-lot lineage quantity
quality gating prevents unaccepted lots from allocation
lot and obligation over-allocation fail closed
limitations: reference workflow remains in-memory in this SW1 product slice; durable lineage primitives already exist from SW0
no production warehouse UI or device integration
next: SW1-06 pick/pack/pickup, acceptance and exception workflow
